In May 2026 Thunderbird suddenly disappeared, as if it had been uninstalled, but I have no idea why.   I managed to reinstall it and rediscovered the server details needed to reconnect to my account and fortunately had a slightly old back up (from Nov 2025) of previously saved emails.  This has worked OK now for about a month. Today the same thing has happened again - The Thunderbird icon on my desktop does not connect to anything and has just turned into a white "blank page" icon. I may be able to get the account back by doing the same tedious process again, but I am concerned that this may keep happening and I don't know why. This is a work laptop running Windows 11 so its possible I suppose that some sort of security software may be doing this without notifying me??    I am using Thunderbird to access a personal (ie not work) email account so maybe my work systems don't like that?   As mentioned, it has worked fine for years so I dont know where the  problem lies but it is worrying and annoying. PlusNet last year transferred all email accounts to another UK provider (Greenby) but that has worked OK and I cannot see how that would affect email client software. BJ
